comparator.name: Automotive Technology
comparator.sourceNotes: Verified 1 November 2026 against the 2026–2027 After Revision PER Arts1.1,3.3–3.7 and Appendix2, the current curriculum PDF dated2July2026, current bachelor public page and linked major regulations/elective/project pages. Automotive Technology is the named core/major within the Electrical Engineering BSc, not a separate formal degree or a master specialization. English, full-time; post2023 entrant rules. Core125EC including compulsory10EC project, ITEC10EC and free electives45EC. All27 distinct positions total180EC: Y1 60; Y2 40core+5ITEC+15open; Y3 25core+5ITEC+30open. Open space requires30EC level2/3 including15EC level3, no overlap within electives or with core, prerequisites/timeslots and examination-programme approval via PlanApp. No optional course is imposed on open space. Bachelor project entry120EC including all required first-year components; two consecutive quarters, ordinary Q3–Q4 of year3, Q1 only with advisor permission. The nominal completed first two years satisfy entry. Multi-disciplinary CBL entry requires prior offered embedded communication/collaboration/planning components completed; nominal ordered pathway does so. Five ITEC-logo Studium Generale activities and MyFuture activities totalling value7 are non-credit obligations; P&PD embedded in core. First-year positive BSA normally requires45/60EC, satisfied by nominal complete year1. The current curriculum calls4AUB10 Propulsion Systems while the PER table retains an electric/hybrid powertrain label for the same5EC code; identity/credit/status agree, use current title without inferring a particular detailed engine or battery syllabus. Optional perception/autonomy/electric-drive courses remain elective possibilities, not compulsory formation.

alternatives.label: Mathematical modelling, autonomous & connected systems
alternatives.concept: Study autonomous and connected systems through mathematical models, programming, data analysis, computer vision, robot motion, learning agents and communication networks. Product design and life-cycle analysis connect these methods to practical system choices. Mobility is an application of these methods; vehicle hardware and propulsion are not taught as a specialist sequence.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is predominantly mathematical and computational, with sustained perception/decision/robotic-motion and network study. Product design and life-cycle analysis are real supporting contributions. No vehicle-specific project, electronics or mechanics sequence is promised.
progression: Current workbook offerings and every formal earlier prerequisite verified in the fixed Fall2026-start horizon. Introductory Data Science now precedes Machine Learning, which precedes Neural Networks. Linear Algebra precedes Robotics. These advisory preferences were feasible without changing the concepts. Advanced Calculus remains later than Linear Systems/Numerical Methods because its offering and formal prerequisites permit this sequence. Algorithms & Data Structures precedes Advanced Algorithms.

alternatives.label: Intelligent systems, sustainable energy & product design
alternatives.concept: Combine mathematical models, perception, robot motion and intelligent decisions with renewable-energy conversion and system design, life-cycle assessment and material recovery. The programme examines how intelligent products and their energy and material systems can be designed and evaluated. It offers methods relevant to lower-impact mobility, without specialist vehicle powertrain or battery engineering.
alternatives.labelReason: Six sustainability/energy/material courses including two gateways implement a distinct physical-energy and product-impact emphasis alongside intelligent-system methods. The title describes this completed combination without implying a transport-specific project or automotive qualification.
progression: Current workbook offerings and every formal earlier prerequisite verified in the fixed Fall2026-start horizon. Introductory Data Science now precedes Machine Learning, which precedes Neural Networks. Linear Algebra precedes Robotics. These advisory preferences were feasible without changing the concepts. Advanced Calculus remains later than Linear Systems/Numerical Methods because its offering and formal prerequisites permit this sequence.
alternatives.distinctness: Five courses /37.5EC differ in each direction. Logic, databases, networks, advanced algorithms and AI ethics give way to physical/material sustainability foundations, renewable-energy conversion/storage, renewable-system design and resource recovery. This changes the organising emphasis from connected computational infrastructure to energy and material assessment; it is not cosmetic relabelling.

candidates.label: Sustainable electric mobility and product systems
Vehicle mechanics, propulsion and electromechanical integration

selection.assessment: Two concepts pass. Closest response materially addresses the bachelor's explicit electronics/software, information-system and self-driving/connected-mobility orientation through sustained model, perception, decision and motion methods. It does not reproduce vehicle engineering. The second shifts37.5EC towards physical energy conversion/storage, sustainability foundations, system design and resource recovery. Vehicle mechanics/propulsion/electromechanical integration cannot form a further coherent24-course specialist response in the current catalogue. Stop at two; no invented autonomous or energy elective track is attributed to TU/e.

notes.text: Automotive Technology integrates mechanics, electronics, electromechanics, power conversion, embedded hardware, vehicle networks, propulsion, road-vehicle dynamics, laboratories and an automotive final project. The UCR curricula support computational autonomous systems or sustainable energy/product systems related to mobility; they do not reproduce that complete vehicle-engineering formation.

audience.programmeDescription: Automotive Technology at TU/e is a major within the Electrical Engineering bachelor. This English-taught programme studies cars as integrated systems, combining electronics, software, sensing and control with vehicle dynamics, propulsion and energy conversion. Design challenges and a final bachelor project develop the application of these fields.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The first UCR programme develops mathematical and computational methods for autonomous and connected systems. The second combines intelligent-system methods with sustainable energy and product assessment. These are related academic responses: neither supplies the specialist circuits, embedded hardware, vehicle dynamics, propulsion and power-electronics formation of the TU/e major.

Five Studium Generale activities and MyFuture activities totalling value seven are additional non-credit requirements.

componentNotes.cp-000261-y3-open-5: The remaining 30 EC of the same 45-EC elective space; subject to its level, non-overlap, prior-knowledge and approval rules.
